name: Griseofulvin

fda.text: Prophylactic Usage Safety and efficacy of griseofulvin for prophylaxis of fungal infections have not been established. Serious Skin Reactions Severe skin reactions (e.g. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) and erythema multiforme have been reported with griseofulvin use. These reactions may be…

summary: Warnings for griseofulvin note that it has not been proven safe or effective for preventing fungal infections before they start [3]. The label also warns that severe, serious skin reactions, including conditions like Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, and erythema multiforme, have been reported with its use [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests done on actual people, produced low risk scores of 49 for the liver and 36 for the heart [M].
